title: Next Prime Minister of Sweden
description:
Parliamentary elections are scheduled to be held in Sweden on September 13, 2026. 

This market will resolve to the next individual who is officially appointed and assumes office as Prime Minister of Sweden following the next parliamentary election.

To count for resolution, the individual must officially assume office. Any interim or caretaker Prime Minister will not count toward the resolution of this market.

If no such Prime Minister assumes office by June 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “Other”.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the Government of Sweden; however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Recent polling trends show Sweden's Social Democrats consistently leading with around 32-34% support ahead of the September 13, 2026 general election, placing their leader Magdalena Andersson in a strong position to form the next government as prime minister. The incumbent Moderate-led bloc, including the Sweden Democrats, trails with combined support near 44%, limiting Ulf Kristersson's prospects despite his efforts to secure a majority coalition. Trader consensus reflected in current prices aligns with these patterns, where the opposition's polling edge and historical precedent for shifts in parliamentary majorities drive the implied probabilities. Key factors include voter priorities on economic issues and integration, with limited movement in recent surveys leaving the outcome closely tied to final campaign developments.
